purpose: Track the derived contemporary mortality rates and the historical game estimates, including their distinct evidence status and remaining review needs.
estimate_acceptance_policy: A scenario may use a clearly labeled game estimate when direct statistics are unavailable. Direct observation is not a release prerequisite. Keep the estimate range, evidence basis, uncertainty, and gameplay use visible; review balance and consistency before enabling the scenario.

conversion_policy.preferred_measure: one-year probability of death q_x between exact age x and x+1
conversion_policy.wpp_2024_source: Sex-specific and both-sexes life-table survivors l(x) at exact age, 1950-2023 estimates and 2024-2100 Medium variant projection; derive q_x=1-l_(x+1)/l_x from adjacent ages in the same country, year, and sex series.
conversion_policy.from_survivors: For a compatible period life table with positive l_x, q_x = 1 - l_(x+1)/l_x.
conversion_policy.from_central_rate: Do not treat central death rate m_x as q_x. Store the source definition and document a justified conversion before use.
conversion_policy.quarterly_equal_hazard: q_quarter = 1 - (1 - q_x)^(1/4); an explicit within-year constant hazard assumption.
conversion_policy.public_release: Requires age, period, population, geography, sex category, uncertainty, and successor-period coverage review. When estimates are used, label them as game estimates and retain their range. Confirm licenses for source-derived data.

enablement_policy: Missing empirical rates do not block use by themselves. Keep public_enabled false only until a scenario has a complete playable estimate or data series, clear labels, coherent event risks, and a reviewed sensitivity range.

modern_source.title: World Population Prospects 2024, MORT/F04 life-table survivors at exact age
modern_source.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO; retain attribution and confirm release-specific terms
modern_source.derived_data_coverage: Japan, China, India, Mali, France; years 1950-2100; exact ages 0-99 plus an estimated 100+ open interval; annual q_x; estimates 1950-2023 and Medium variant projection 2024-2100.
modern_source.transformation: Read WPP MORT/F04 exact-age l(x) by country, year, and sex series; calculate q_x = 1 - l(x+1)/l(x) for ages 0-99. Estimate q_100+ by extending the nonnegative logit slope from q_98 to q_99, capped at 0.99. The terminal interval is a low-confidence game estimate, not a WPP value.
modern_source.use_limit: National period life tables, not city-level observation. Estimates and Medium variant projection remain separately labelled. The 100+ interval is a documented extrapolation, not an observed WPP rate.

jp_historical.candidate: Rural agrarian authoring curve with an infant central estimate of 0.205 and a 0.18-0.23 range; supported only as a loose fit by a study of northeastern Tokugawa infant mortality, not as a Niita measurement.
jp_historical.known_limit: Inter-register infant deaths may be absent; raw register counts cannot supply q0. Remaining age rates are low-confidence game estimates.
jp_historical.must_not_transfer: Nishijo village estimates are not Niita rates.
